item.title: fix(ai): skip malformed thinking signatures during replay (#123228)
item.summary: fix(ai): skip malformed thinking signatures during replay (#123228) Responses replay parsed persisted thinking signatures without validating their JSON shape, so corrupt or unrelated values could prevent every later turn in a session. Parse signatures in the shared replay owner and accept only reasoning records. Cover malformed syntax, null, arrays, and wrong item types through both provider- and transport-style converters.
